sentence_stem: Although most students prefer studying in the library,
correct_completion: a few still choose to work at home.
full_sentence: Although most students prefer studying in the library, a few still choose to work at home.
acceptable_variants: some still prefer to study alone at home.
a minority continue to work from home.

options.text: so the library is always crowded.
options.why_wrong: 'So' expresses a result. 'Although' requires a contrast with the first part, not a consequence.

options.text: a few still choose to work at home.
most of them study late at night.
options.why_wrong: This adds a related fact but does not contrast with the preference for the library.

options.text: the library opens at eight every day.
options.why_wrong: This gives a factual detail about the library and does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must contrast with the first part of the sentence. Here the majority preference for the library is contrasted with a small group who work at home. Learners may choose a result connector such as 'so' by mistake, which breaks the contrast.
translation: Embora a maioria dos alunos prefira estudar na biblioteca, alguns ainda escolhem trabalhar em casa.
